question: Does max_chunk move the published ECE gap, or only individual confidences?
verdict: Individual confidences move by up to 0.0043 under fp16, but the perturbations are unbiased and cancel in aggregate: no prediction changes label and ECE moves by 4.6e-05. The published 0.5B-vs-1.5B gap is ~900x that, so it is not an artefact of chunk sizing.
aside: Chunking finer than necessary costs time: ~716ms per item at chunk=8 against ~192ms at chunk=77, for identical answers.
reproducibility_note: This experiment was run twice on the same machine. Every accuracy, ECE and mean-confidence figure was identical to the last recorded digit across both runs; only the latency column differed (634/331/206 ms the first time, 716/317/192 ms the second), because timing tracks machine load. That the metrics are bit-stable while the timings are not is itself part of the answer: the quantities the conclusion rests on do not move.
